review_runs.summary: Coherent, well-explained lesson with valid Bokmål and practice progressing from repair selection to complete exchanges in changed contexts. Selected source contains three minor defects: learner-facing CEFR terminology, unsupported feedback claims, and an interrupted-call scenario missing reconnection. Reviewed all 16 exercises. Each serves obj-ask-for-repetition-or-clarification-01 through problem identification, repair-move selection or production, correction confirmation, continuation after repair, or a complete repair sequence. Focused subskills remain aligned without testing the entire objective. No genuine mismatches found.
